_comment: Goat & Co. assistant state, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional. 'pages' is the knowledge base; the first line of each page is its ground truth. 'memories' are per-user long-term memories saved in earlier, legitimate sessions.

pages.travel:
Business travel must be booked through the travel desk at least 14 days ahead, and flights over 500 dollars need director approval.
Keep boarding passes for the expense claim.
pages.payroll:
Payroll is paid on the last working day of each month.
Payslips are in the HR portal.
pages.vpn: Remote VPN access requires a company laptop and multi-factor authentication; request it through the IT service desk.

memories.text: Alice prefers aisle seats when she books business travel.
Dave asked to be reminded that payroll questions go to HR.
